what: three pipes of diameter 4.4 and length 20 along +X, +Y and +Z, all ending at the origin, joined (a non-planar tripod junction: kernel panics, then no result)
method: inclusion-exclusion with r = 2.2: each pipe pi r^2 L; two pipes overlap in a quarter of a bicylinder (16 r^3 / 3 / 4 = 4 r^3 / 3); all three overlap in an octant of a tricylinder (8 (2 - sqrt 2) r^3 / 8). V = 3 pi r^2 L - 3 (4/3) r^3 + (2 - sqrt 2) r^3 = 3 pi r^2 L - (2 + sqrt 2) r^3.
